The dependency check confirms it: `package.json` still pins `fast-parse` at `1.4.2`, and `NOTES.md` says that exact version was yanked over a prototype-pollution report, with `1.4.3` as the fix. Nothing else in `NOTES.md` needs action — `date-fmt` is called out as unmaintained but harmless, and `pg-lite`/`redis-min` are current.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. SQL injection in `src/repo/report.js` — filter and sort values pasted straight into the query
2. No auth on `src/routes/internal.js` — leftover from the dropped VPN requirement
3. Hardcoded staging DB password in `config/staging.js`
4. `fast-parse` still on the yanked `1.4.2`, needs `1.4.3`

Service code wasn't touched — this was audit only.
